# zero-touch-second-brain

> Self-hosted AI second brain for coding agents. Persistent memory in plain Markdown, with an Obsidian-compatible vault.

## Overview

zero-touch-second-brain turns clipboard drops and finished coding-agent sessions
into atomic lessons, a ten-rule retrieval index and a health report. It runs
locally on Termux, Linux and macOS. OpenCode drives the full loop; community
adapters bring the same rules to Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and
Windsurf. The project is MIT licensed and uses plain Markdown files, so the
vault stays readable without any vendor.

## Key Features

- Capture: clipboard and session drafts with SHA-256 deduplication and redaction.
- Distillation: at most five atomic lessons and one protocol per session.
- Retrieval: a short top-rules index that agents read at session start.
- Triage: inbox files with a manifest and an audit trail.
- Verification: vault lint, learning gate, health JSON and eight automated tests.
- Benchmarked agent routing: 100/100 on an eleven-scenario suite.
